spaceId.description: An identifier for the space. If `/s/` and the identifier are omitted from the path, the default space is used.

at.description: The point in time at which to compute the SLO instance summary (ISO 8601 date-time)

instanceId.description: The SLO instance ID. Omit this parameter or set it to `'*'` to return all instances for the SLO (up to 1000). Set a specific value (for example `host.name:web-01`) to return that instance only.
